text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Another intense summer training camp had 
come to an end, and as for Gentildonna...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, pardon me. So you heard that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Just a little triumphant song of victory 
from an opera.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a song fitting for how I feel 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This power I've honed... I can't wait to 
unleash it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
Gentildonna had shown remarkable growth.
